description: Canonical inputs required by tools/regress_checks.json. All paths are relative to the repo root. Most are gitignored (ROM copyright + RE captures); sha256 pins the local copy when recorded. Run: python tools/regress.py --check-inputs NOTE ON `kind`: the vocabulary is not normalised -- the 25 entries catalogued before 2026-08-30 use their own words (raw_wram/lakestate/lakewram_wrapper/flag_page) and the 37 added that day use oracle_wram/lake_state/lake_wram/story_flags for the same things. Nothing reads this field; it is left as written rather than rewritten, because re-labelling an entry someone else recorded is a change with no derivation behind it.
